integrity: All displayed asymptotics are proved analytically. Finite enumeration and numerical checks are corroborative only. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a Rayleigh-quotient upper witness, not an exact evaluation of the projected spectral gap.
It does not determine c_2^star or claim global optimality of the n^{-1/4} approach rate.
The 1/sqrt(2) coefficient is optimal only inside the stated balanced two-parameter scaling class.
The full text of arXiv:2608.08678 was not directly retrievable during comparison; the later primary paper's related-work discussion and explicit no-rate statement were inspected.
title: An \(n^{-1/4}\) finite-window approach to the two-state sliding-count obstruction
